summary: Build the formal core of the carbon-nitrogen accounting behind the Solar Wing nitrogen-delivery study: the ceiling a fixed C:N ratio puts on new carbon, when added nitrogen raises carbon gain and when it gives nothing, and the bound on ecosystem carbon held in pools of different C:N ratios, each sealed as a statement under the standing sealing policy and proved under the pinned Lean toolchain.
title: Forest carbon and nitrogen: the stoichiometric ceiling on carbon gain
